thirdPartyReference.description: The unique reference for this customer which can help to identify them later on. If the email is left empty, this should be empty as well.

email.description: The email address for this customer.

contactNumberAsE164.description: The customer phone number in E164 format.

notes.description: The notes attached to the customer.

salutation.description: Salutation for the customer (Mr., Mrs., Dr., etc...).

sendEmailReceipts.description: Default value of emailNotification setting for new customers

emailNotification.description: Update the customer email notification setting. For example, sendEmailReceipts = true, emailNotification = DONT_CHANGE - sends receipt email for all users who haven't disabled it in the Backoffice. sendEmailReceipts = false, emailNotification = DONT_CHANGE - will not send receipt email for all users except those who enabled it in the Backoffice
